# custovox.ai

> custovox.ai reads your customer conversations — calls, reviews, support tickets and emails — and shows what your customers are telling you that your metrics don't: emotions, recurring irritants, escalation risk and churn-risk signals. 5 native languages, no data team, data hosted in France. Published by Corpstxt (SASU, Wambrechies, France). The easiest way to try it is the free case study: 100 of your reviews or tickets analyzed, results within 48 hours, no credit card.

## Who it is for
- Customer success, customer experience, support and call-center teams that collect thousands of reviews, tickets, emails or calls and cannot read them all.
- SMBs and mid-market companies looking for a lighter, GDPR-compliant alternative to enterprise VoC suites (e.g. Qualtrics, Medallia), with published prices.
- Developers: open-source MCP servers usable from Claude Code, Claude Desktop or any MCP client (see below).

## Key facts
- Plans (excl. tax): Starter $89/month, Growth $299/month, Scale $699/month on the English site (USD); Starter €89, Growth €299, Scale €699 per month excl. VAT on the French site (EUR); Enterprise on quote. Yearly billing = 2 months free. Details: https://custovox.ai/pricing
- Every plan (monthly or yearly) renews automatically and can be cancelled at any time; cancellation takes effect at the end of the current period.
- 4 analysis modules: TextIQ (sentiment, emotions, topics, summaries of reviews/tickets/emails — all plans), PredictIQ (churn-risk score 0–100 per customer — Growth and above), VoiceIQ (call transcription, emotions, escalation detection — Scale), VisualIQ (customer photos — Scale). Plus SearchIQ, semantic search across the customer archive (Growth and above).
- Native languages: English, French, German, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese.
- Integrations: CSV / Excel import on all plans; Zendesk, Freshdesk, HubSpot, Salesforce in beta on request (Growth and above); full API on Scale.
- Analyses run with custovox.ai's own models and scripts.

## Data protection (single source: https://custovox.ai/security-gdpr)
- Customer data is hosted in France, encrypted in transit and at rest, and never used to train or improve models.
- A data processing agreement compliant with GDPR Article 28 is signed with every paying customer; Enterprise customers can get a custom DPA.
- Retention: free case study — 30 days after report delivery; active subscription — contract duration + 30 days; optional longitudinal history — 24 rolling months; after cancellation — 30 days to retrieve data, then permanent deletion. On written request, deletion within 72 hours, whatever the situation.

## Evidence, and what each figure means
- 427,536 real interactions analyzed in custovox.ai's foundational research, before launch: 4 studies in 4 domains (customer reviews, medical consultations, corporate communications…), 5 NLP methods validated. Research: https://custovox.ai/research
- 483,724+ customer conversations analyzed in total: the 427,536 research interactions plus the conversations analyzed since (studies, customer analyses and tests).
- R²=0.848 on custovox.ai's customer-satisfaction model: 84.8% of the variation in customer satisfaction is explained, on test data independent from the training corpus. This measures satisfaction modelling; it is not, by itself, a measure of churn-prediction accuracy.
- PredictIQ's churn-risk score ranks customers by the linguistic patterns associated with departure risk in their messages (word associations, recurring expressions, tone shifts). It is a risk ranking to prioritize follow-up, not a guarantee: no general precision, recall or lead-time figure is published yet.
- The G2 review study (200 reviews) found onboarding confusion in 34% of the negative reviews — a share of negative reviews, not of all customers: https://custovox.ai/blog/g2-reviews-nlp-analysis

## Open-source MCP servers (GitHub, PyPI and the official MCP registry)
- custovox-sentiment — 5-level sentiment (Very Negative → Very Positive), EN/FR/DE/ES/PT-BR, batch up to 50 texts: https://pypi.org/project/custovox-sentiment/
- custovox-emotion — 7 labels (joy, anger, fear, sadness, surprise, disgust, neutral), English, batch up to 50 texts: https://pypi.org/project/custovox-emotion/
- custovox-ticket-scorer — support ticket priority, category, sentiment and escalation risk (priority and category most accurate in English): https://pypi.org/project/custovox-ticket-scorer/
- custovox-review-analyzer — sentiment breakdown of up to 100 customer reviews, with short summaries of the positive and negative reviews (multilingual sentiment, English summaries): https://pypi.org/project/custovox-review-analyzer/
- They run locally with open models; the hosted custovox.ai platform adds the modules, reports, integrations and data protection above.

## Customer-experience data cited in custovox.ai articles (third-party sources)
- 40% of US customers stopped buying from a company after poor customer service (2020).
- Customer retention rate by industry: hospitality 55%, retail 63%, media 84% (CustomerGauge / MIT CISR, 2018 data).
- 61% of US e-commerce companies use AI for customer service (OnePoll / Storyblok, 2025).
- 12% of call centers don't track customer satisfaction (CTI Forum / Liveops).
- US online retail customer satisfaction (ACSI): 78 in 2000, 79 in 2026.
